fonts.display: 'ABCCameraPlainVariable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'SerialC-Heavy', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cream Paper
palette.role: Page canvas, soft section background — warm off-white with a barely-there pink cast, never pure white

palette.name: Pure Card
palette.role: Card surfaces, elevated panels, button text on violet fills

palette.name: Ash Mist
palette.role: Tertiary surface, muted dividers, subtle background washes

palette.name: Carbon Black
palette.role: Primary text, default borders, icon strokes — the structural ink of the system

palette.name: Graphite Input
palette.role: Input field borders, secondary dark surfaces

palette.name: Obsidian Pill
palette.role: Dark CTA fill — the secondary action button (e.g. Reserve), pairs with white text and violet shadow

palette.name: Electric Violet
palette.role: Primary accent — link borders, active states, icon highlights, section accent borders. The brand's signal color

palette.name: Lilac Pill
palette.role: Primary CTA button fill — the dominant call-to-action, sits on violet hard shadow with black text

palette.name: Deep Plum
palette.role: Dark violet text variant, deep accent borders, section-level emphasis when Electric Violet feels too bright

palette.name: Shadow Plum
palette.role: Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Acid Lime
palette.role: Sparingly used highlight wash or accent surface for urgency moments (limited drops, reservation states)

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Outlined action border — secondary ghost button or informational outline accent
